tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: Data color (exempt from chrome roles). Worker is running or a step succeeded. Text on surface, surface-container-low, surface-container-high and its own soft fill.

tokens.name: status-running-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the running status chip.

tokens.name: status-provisioning
tokens.usage: Data color (exempt from chrome roles). Provisioning, booting, pairing in progress, informational. Text on surface, surface-container-low, surface-container-high and its own soft fill.

tokens.name: status-provisioning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the provisioning status chip.

tokens.name: status-draining
tokens.usage: Data color (exempt from chrome roles). Draining, stopping, warnings such as a near cost cap or an expiring code. Text on surface, surface-container-low, surface-container-high and its own soft fill.

tokens.name: status-draining-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the draining status chip.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Data color (exempt from chrome roles). Failed: launch, login, pairing or task. Always with the word and an icon. Text on surface, surface-container-low, surface-container-high and its own soft fill.

tokens.name: status-failed-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the failed status chip.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Data color (exempt from chrome roles). Stopped, idle, not started, skipped. Text on surface, surface-container-low, surface-container-high and its own soft fill.

tokens.name: status-idle-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the idle status chip.
